people.name: 冷湾·折弦
people.motive: 他是被更年轻的全朔比下去的弦朔。他收过路银，是为了让半张脸继续没有资格被晋升。
people.look: a middle-aged night-shadow exile around 38, sharp lean face, one eye rimmed by a broken half-circle of thin silver string along the pupil edge, cold grey-black hair tied back, dark slate night coat with frosted-silver clasps, a coiled thin silver measuring string in one hand, bitter controlled expression of someone outranked by a younger full-shadow

people.name: 碧潭·澜芷
people.motive: 她是染缕。她给继承人一页干净的玉缕，因为不能涂改的牒会暴露她，也因为她真的怕阈值崩掉。
people.look: a qinghe archive clerk around 32, neat scholar bun, hair dyed to a false jade-strand green-black sheen at the tips, pale precise face, ink-navy scholar robe with a frosted-silver seal-case sash, a rolled clean jade-register page in one hand, careful calculating eyes

people.name: 白垣·计勋
people.motive: 折杆的旧同事。他要分数仍然有效。授旗若传给没有点亮的孩子，他会抢走分数更高的那个。
people.look: a middle-aged ashbanner marshal around 46, square jaw, short greying black hair, formal marshal coat in slate and frost white with a small ashbanner crest clasp, holding a scored merit tablet and a folded nomination roster, stern scorekeeping eyes, posture of a career officer who trusts numbers over blood

people.name: 南灯·欠盏
people.motive: 真灯丝，空钱袋。她要把香盏收成特许验具，让照不见的人改由收据说明。她不伪造自己的脸。
people.look: a lantern merchant around 40, true faint luminous filament strands in the hair tips, tired elegant face of a bankrupt former lamp-throne holder, ink-navy merchant coat with empty purse straps, a clear glass incense censer offered like merchandise, wry practical eyes that sell readability not forged faces

people.name: 观象·孤衡
people.motive: 星津没有七星，她就摄政。她可以承认灰旗的继承人，条件是桥外与测距不要有孩子。
people.look: a middle-aged starriver regent-astronomer around 52, silver-streaked black hair in a high observatory pin, cool angular face, ink-navy and frost-white star-chart robe with thin cyan constellation trim, an open star-chart tablet in one hand, composed absolute eyes of someone guarding an empty throne
